M-Cn: Hello, you've reached Custom Gifts. How can I help you? W-Br: I'd like to order 200 mugs with my café's logo. We're doing some promotional giveaways for the grand opening of our second location, so I'll need them by next Friday. M-Cn: Oh, that's soon. But I can make this an express order so we'll make that deadline. It'll cost a bit extra. And you'll have to e-mail us your logo. W-Br: OK, that's fine. Can you tell me what color mugs are available? I'd like to give customers a choice.

M-Au: Hi, Paloma? W-Br: Yes, this is Paloma. M-Au: Hi, it's Takumi Sato, from the International Orchestra. W-Br: It's good to hear from you, Mr. Sato. M-Au: The committee and I listened to the recordings you gave us. Your performances at the Galveston Festival were fantastic. W-Br: Oh, I'm glad you liked them. M-Au: We also enjoyed your interview. We've decided to offer you the position. W-Br: That's wonderful! There's one thing I should let you know about, though. I saw that rehearsals for the next season begin in July, but I'll be traveling in Japan during the first week of July. Will that be a problem?

M-Cn: Hi, Emiko and Fatima. Thanks for coming in early to set up for this evening's event. This is the first time JMA Technologies is hosting their annual fund-raiser here, and I think it'll really increase our hotel's visibility. W-Br: Of course. What do you need? M-Cn: Well, JMA has a new AV equipment request. Initially, they wanted only a podium and microphone, but now they'd also like a projector and a screen. W-Br: I can set that up now. M-Cn: Thanks, Emiko. Fatima, while she's working on that, can you make sure the place settings on the tables are all in order? W-Am: Sure—let me get the seating chart layout so I can check each table against it.

M-Cn: Hi, I think I lost my mobile phone while I was shopping here yesterday. The last time I remember using it was in the frozen food aisle. Has anyone turned in a phone? W-Br: Let me check. What does it look like? M-Cn: It has a green protector case with a picture of a motorcycle on the back. W-Br: Ah, here it is. M-Cn: Thank you so much. Oh. How much are these canned peaches? I forgot to buy them when I was here yesterday. W-Br: They're two dollars.

W-Br: Hey, Omar. I know we'd planned to meet today to review résumés for the open junior accountant position, but I'm just swamped. M-Cn: Oh, what's going on? W-Br: Well, you know I have to finish the quarterly tax filings for two of my top clients... so could we review the résumés tomorrow? M-Cn: It won't take that long. I've already gone through them and separated out the candidates with the accounting experience we're looking for. We just need to decide who to interview. W-Br: OK. But I'll have to leave right at five o'clock, because I have a dentist appointment after work.

M-Cn: Irina, do you have the results from our latest employee satisfaction survey? W-Br: Yes, and based on the comments, the majority of our employees want us to make the company more environmentally friendly. Apparently, they feel that we don't do enough to promote recycling efforts. M-Cn: Hmm, that reminds me about an article I read recently. It said that eco-friendly companies tend to have higher employee satisfaction rates. W-Br: In that case, why don't we bring in an outside consultant? We can hire someone who's an expert on finding ways to promote sustainability.

M-Au: Sofia, how was the graphic design conference in Sacramento? W-Am: Very good. I especially enjoyed the sessions on customer service. I think it'll help me serve our clients better. M-Au: Great! By the way, have you seen the latest expense report for our design department? W-Am: Not yet. Why? M-Au: We've already exceeded our quarterly budget. We really need to restrict our spending now. So I'm asking everyone to come up with ideas for cutting our department's expenses. Could you write up some ideas by two o'clock today? W-Am: That'll be quite challenging. M-Au: I know you just got back, but this is important. W-Am: OK. I'll talk to my assistant and have her clear my schedule for the rest of the morning.

W-Br: This is Springfield Community Center. How can I help you? M-Au: Hi, I'm with the local historical club. We're looking for a place for our monthly meetings. W-Br: OK. We have a few rooms that community organizations can reserve. When are your meetings held? M-Au: The first Saturday of each month. W-Br: Oh, that's a very popular time. You'll have to reserve the space well in advance. M-Au: No problem. I'll do that. Also, I saw that you have a message board at the front of the building. Can groups use it to advertise their events? W-Br: Yes. Notices can be posted a week in advance.

W-Am: Hi, I'm calling because I'm redesigning a hotel lobby for a client, and I'd like the reception countertop to be made of stone. M-Cn: We have slabs of granite and marble here in our showroom. You can stop by and choose the one you want. W-Am: Great—I'll be there this afternoon. Also... how long will it take before the countertop's installed? M-Cn: For a basic rectangular shape, it takes a week to cut it to size, polish it, and install it. If you have the exact length and width, we can get started as soon as you make your selection. W-Am: I'll bring the dimensions.

W-Am: Congratulations! As top employees at NGR Industries, you've been selected for our Future Leaders Program. In this program, you'll be rotating through jobs in each division to learn everything about our company. Now my colleague, Ms. Park, will continue. W-Br: Thanks, Margaret. This rotational program is critical to becoming a successful manager here. Oh... there's a question in the back? M-Cn: Yes, thank you, Ms. Park. I was wondering how long we'll spend in each department. W-Br: You'll work in one department for about two months and then move to another area. Preferences for first assignments will be taken into consideration. You may indicate your preference on the form in front of you.

W-Br: Welcome to Smith's Sports Equipment and More. How may I help you? M-Au: Hi, uh, my brother and I often go biking in the mountains, and I'd like to buy an exterior bike rack for my car. W-Br: I can help you with that. We have several sizes available. What carrying capacity do you need? M-Au: Something small... one that can carry up to two bikes, but no more. W-Br: Here's a list of our models. We have just what you need. M-Au: OK. Is it difficult to attach to the car? I hope it's not too complicated. W-Br: Don't worry. It comes with detailed, step-by-step instructions to install it.

M-Au: Hello. This is Vogel's Laundry Service. W-Br: Hi, I'm calling from the Happy Stay Hotel on Forbes Avenue. We're looking for an outside service to wash the hotel's bedding and towels, and I've heard good things about you. M-Au: I'm glad to hear that. Our customers will tell you that we're very trustworthy—we're known for our reliable service. W-Br: So... what time would you be delivering our clean linens each day? M-Au: It depends on the location. If you take a look at the online delivery map, you'll see that you're in Zone 2. W-Br: Oh, I see it now. That would work. The housekeeping staff doesn't start until nine o'clock, so that gives us plenty of time.

W-Am: Hello, Midtown Health Clinic. M-Au: Hi. I have an appointment scheduled with Dr. Miller for two o'clock on Wednesday, but I need to change it. I have an important client meeting I need to attend. W-Am: OK. What time would you be able to come in? M-Au: Well, I get out of work at five o'clock, so any time after that is fine. W-Am: Dr. Miller doesn't have anything past four o'clock this week. But there's an opening at five thirty on Friday with a different doctor? M-Au: OK, that's fine. W-Am: Great. Let me ask you a few questions to be sure that none of your information has changed.

W-Am: Hello, Fairview Apartment residents. This is your property manager. Due to repairs to the main water line along Chasman Boulevard, water service to all units at Fairview will be temporarily shut off on July fifteenth. I estimate that regular service will resume fully by five o'clock, though I recommend checking the building's social media page periodically. There'll be updates posted about possible delays. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

W-Br: Before we begin tonight's dinner shift, I have some announcements. Our grilled tuna dish was so popular last night that we actually sold out of it for the rest of the weekend. Please let diners know that it's not available. Also, we'll be dividing up the servers this evening—half of you will be working in the main dining room, and the rest of you will be in the special-events room for a private party. It's going to be a busy evening, so I encourage you to help each other provide great service for our customers.

W-Am: Good morning! I really appreciate this opportunity to talk to you about investing in our company. After hearing my presentation, you'll see that our latest product is a worthwhile investment. Cygni Fashions has been selling business suits for more than 30 years. Last summer, when the weather was unusually hot, we decided to design suits that would be comfortable to wear when it's hot outside. People who wear these suits remain cool, regardless of the temperature. Now, these suits have become so popular that we cannot keep up with the demand. With your investment, we'll be able to purchase some advanced machinery that would allow us to triple our production.

M-Cn: I'm Thomas Ortiz, head of Human Resources here at Hamilton Power. On behalf of the company, I want to welcome you all to your new jobs. As you know, this is our most advanced power plant, and we provide electricity to over a half-million homes. I'm sure you're all eager to go to your workstations. But there is a lot of paperwork to fill out. I'll be going over it with you in a moment. But first, I'd like to take your pictures for your ID badges. They'll be ready for you after lunch.

M-Au: Hi, Mario. I'm calling about tonight. I know you plan to be at the product launch in Holtsville to announce the release of our new smartphone. You mentioned that you're taking the red subway line to that event. Well, I just found out that the subway line is closed unexpectedly for repairs. So, I wanted to let you know, I'll be driving to Holtsville from the office. Now, I have to make one stop on the way. I have to pick up the promotional materials that'll be handed out to attendees—those phone cases with our company logo. But there's plenty of time to pick the cases up and still make it to the product launch before it starts.

M-Cn: Welcome to this computer security workshop, hosted by the IT Department. This workshop is intended to be interactive, so please ask questions at any time. We scheduled the workshop because several employees' computers have recently become infected with a virus, and they had to be fixed. OK, so the first thing I'm going to show you is how to update your security software. Please open the program by clicking on the icon on the right-hand side of your computer screen.

M-Au: OK, let's get started—there's a lot to cover! First, I want to thank the Web design team for joining this weekly check-in of our editorial staff and reporters. An online organization like ours relies heavily on the support of its design and technical staff. Today I'd like to discuss adding a section to the site that features our most popular news stories. Many other news sites already have a popular stories section. I'm concerned that we're not keeping up with them, and it could affect our readership. Now, I realize you're all busy, but I don't think this will involve too much work. Plus, remember, we have technology interns starting next week.

M-Cn: Hello. This is Jie Liu, reporting live from the Benton Public Library. Starting next week, the library will be undergoing major renovations. A new section will be added to the east side of this building. The addition will include a larger children's section and a computer lab. The library will be open during the renovations, though you may want to bring earplugs to wear. Susan Anderson, the head librarian, warns that the construction will be noisy. And now, back to the studio.

W-Br: Attention shoppers! Thanks for coming to Link Office Superstore's annual sale. We offer the best prices in town on office supplies, desks, and chairs. There are a lot of people here for our special deals today, so lines for the cashiers are long. To help speed up the checkout process, please use the express lane located near the exit if you're buying five items or fewer. Also, if you're purchasing a large item and need help moving it, just let one of the employees know and they'll help you bring the item to your vehicle.

M-Cn: Thanks for coming to today's painting class at the Lightdale Community Center. I hope you enjoyed learning some of the techniques I showed you. If you could collect your brushes and paints and leave them right here on this table, it'll make my cleanup easier. And before you go, I want to remind everyone about the other great events here at the center. There's a copy of the schedule at the door. I recommend the Mystery Book Club meeting, because there will be a special guest that night—the author Gerard Messina will be reading from his latest novel.

Muelker Shipyard Undergoes Transformation

May 2—The Muelker Shipyard, a once-bustling ship manufacturing center, is being given a new role. A team of engineers is working to turn it into an open-air pedestrian mall with restaurants, a dozen retail businesses, and an outdoor patio that will feature live music performances.

Until June of last year, the city had planned to demolish the shipyard—a decision that caused a strong reaction from community members, especially former shipbuilders who viewed the site as a treasured industrial landmark. Wanting their labor to be remembered by future generations, many shipbuilders had etched their names on a wall near the entrance.

“In the peak of production, shipyard workers produced a naval ship in just a year,” said lead engineer, Barney Enyart. “Then production gradually slowed, and the shipyard eventually closed. When this project is complete, the new complex will be enjoyed throughout the year, serving as a place for employment opportunities and recreation while the legacy of the site’s past will endure.”

Green City Screenwriters’ Workshop (GCSW) provides aspiring and practicing screenwriters a place for interaction and exchange of ideas. For the last 25 years, GCSW has helped writers from all over the country develop creative projects.

Are you working on a movie script? Or do you have an idea for the next blockbuster film? Consider applying for the next series of classes at GCSW. We offer writing groups, staged readings, and seminars with guest speakers.

The six class sessions begin on January 10 and are held every other Thursday.
Each class meets from 7 P.M. to 9 P.M. at Green City Foundation for the Arts.
Tuition is $500 in total and due by January 1.
A limited amount of financial aid is available to those who qualify.
Classes are capped at ten students.

Please send a 20-page writing sample (this can be from any genre of writing) and a 200-word autobiographical statement to apply@greencityscreenwriters.org. An instructor will respond to your inquiry if you are accepted.

Joshua Hartzog

questions.stem: Mr. Akagi was unable to buy tickets for the concert because ------- was sold out.
questions.explanation: Cần đại từ số ít thay thế cho danh từ "the concert". "It" (nó) là đại từ ngôi thứ ba số ít phù hợp.

questions.stem: Classes ------- using the new employee scheduling software will begin in December.
questions.explanation: Cần giới từ chỉ chủ đề/nội dung. "Classes on using..." = Các lớp học về cách sử dụng... Giới từ "on" diễn tả chủ đề của lớp học.

questions.stem: Hillsdale Fabrics' ------- collection of leathers was imported from Italy.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "collection". "Diverse" (đa dạng) là tính từ đứng trước danh từ.

questions.stem: A ------- of four dental hygienists spoke about careers in their field.
questions.explanation: "A panel of four dental hygienists" = một hội đồng gồm bốn chuyên viên vệ sinh răng miệng. "Panel" (hội đồng, nhóm thảo luận) là danh từ phù hợp ngữ cảnh nói chuyện về nghề nghiệp.

questions.stem: Ardentine Realty is ------- seeking new rental properties for its portfolio.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "seeking". "Actively" (một cách tích cực) là trạng từ đứng trước động từ.

questions.stem: This Friday, Zone Fly Cameras invites the public to a free aerial photography -------.
questions.explanation: "A free aerial photography workshop" = buổi hội thảo chụp ảnh trên không miễn phí. "Workshop" (buổi hội thảo/lớp thực hành) phù hợp ngữ cảnh mời công chúng tham gia sự kiện.

questions.stem: The Ambury Prize recognizes research that is notable for its ------- and innovation.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu "its" và trước liên từ "and innovation" cần danh từ song song. "Creativity" (sự sáng tạo) là danh từ song song với "innovation".

questions.stem: This year the harvest parade will ------- the village, beginning and ending at the town square.
questions.explanation: "Circle the village" = đi vòng quanh làng. "Circle" (đi vòng quanh) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh diễu hành bắt đầu và kết thúc tại cùng một nơi (quảng trường).

questions.stem: Questwiz, the library's newest database, ------- a wide range of resource materials.
questions.explanation: Câu thiếu động từ chính chia theo chủ ngữ "Questwiz" (ngôi thứ ba số ít). "Contains" (chứa) là động từ chia đúng thì hiện tại đơn.

questions.stem: After more than three years, the application for the new patent was ------- approved.
questions.explanation: "Finally approved" = cuối cùng được phê duyệt. "Finally" (cuối cùng) phù hợp ngữ cảnh chờ đợi hơn ba năm mới được chấp thuận.

questions.stem: The First Street Hotel has almost always been fully booked since it ------- last year.
questions.explanation: Khách sạn là đối tượng được cải tạo (bị động). "Was renovated" (đã được cải tạo) là thể bị động quá khứ đơn phù hợp.

questions.stem: Departments should not spend an ------- amount of their budgets on office supplies.
questions.explanation: "An excessive amount" = một lượng quá mức. "Excessive" (quá mức) phù hợp ngữ cảnh khuyến cáo không chi tiêu quá nhiều ngân sách.

questions.stem: Maxwell Copies prints brochures on thick, glossy paper that was ------- selected for its quality and durability.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ bị động "was selected". "Carefully selected" = được lựa chọn cẩn thận.

questions.stem: ------- Mr. Kamau has worked for Mombasa Communications for two years, he has never taken time off.
questions.explanation: Cần liên từ nhượng bộ nối hai mệnh đề tương phản. "Although" (mặc dù) diễn tả sự tương phản: làm việc hai năm nhưng chưa bao giờ nghỉ phép.

questions.stem: At the Morrighan Hotel, addressing customer feedback is of ------- importance.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "importance" trong cấu trúc "of + adj + N". "Of critical importance" = có tầm quan trọng thiết yếu.

questions.stem: Axofare's new computer program enables users to ------- organize and retrieve data.
questions.explanation: "Efficiently organize and retrieve data" = tổ chức và truy xuất dữ liệu một cách hiệu quả. "Efficiently" phù hợp ngữ cảnh phần mềm máy tính giúp quản lý dữ liệu.

questions.stem: Trelmoni Corporation has just released its ------- of the global stock market.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu "its" cần danh từ. "Analysis" (bản phân tích) là danh từ phù hợp trong cụm "its analysis of the global stock market".

questions.stem: Liu's Foods is pleased to reveal the ------- product in its famous soup line: pumpkin soup.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ so sánh nhất bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "product". Mạo từ "the" + "most popular" + danh từ "product" = sản phẩm phổ biến nhất.

questions.stem: The proposed city budget outlines various projects, ------- renovations of the Fessler Road fire station.
questions.explanation: "Including renovations" = bao gồm việc cải tạo. "Including" (bao gồm) là giới từ dùng để bổ sung ví dụ cụ thể cho "various projects".

questions.stem: The ------- opening of the new bakery had to be postponed when a pipe burst in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: "The scheduled opening" = lễ khai trương đã được lên lịch. "Scheduled" (đã lên lịch) phù hợp ngữ cảnh sự kiện bị hoãn vì sự cố.

questions.stem: Two associates in the accounting department are being ------- for promotions.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động tiếp diễn "are being + V-pp". "Are being considered" = đang được xem xét (để thăng chức).

questions.stem: ------- the rock band Captain Zino decided to offer free tickets to their concert, sales of their album have reached record numbers.
questions.explanation: "Since" (kể từ khi) là liên từ nối mệnh đề chỉ thời gian. Kể từ khi quyết định tặng vé miễn phí, doanh số album đã đạt kỷ lục.

questions.stem: ------- her interview, the committee agreed that Ms. Han was the best candidate for the supervisor job.
questions.explanation: "After her interview" = sau cuộc phỏng vấn của cô ấy. "After" là giới từ chỉ thời gian phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.stem: After monitoring the Hasher Corporation's inventory control process ------- several days, the consultant identified the problem.
questions.explanation: "For several days" = trong nhiều ngày. Giới từ "for" dùng với khoảng thời gian.

questions.stem: Crane operators must check that all moving parts of the machine are fastened ------- before use.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ bị động "are fastened". "Securely fastened" = được buộc chặt an toàn.

questions.stem: Use this coupon to ------- a free quote for cloud storage services.
questions.explanation: "Obtain a free quote" = nhận một báo giá miễn phí. "Obtain" (nhận, có được) phù hợp ngữ cảnh sử dụng phiếu giảm giá để lấy báo giá.

questions.stem: By testing the ------- of the vehicle in desert terrain, the designers proved that it works perfectly in harsh conditions.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ "the" cần danh từ. "The endurance of the vehicle" = sức bền của xe. "Endurance" (sức bền) là danh từ phù hợp.

questions.stem: The flashing yellow light serves as an ------- that the camera's battery needs to be charged.
questions.explanation: "Serves as an alert" = đóng vai trò như một cảnh báo. "Alert" (cảnh báo) phù hợp ngữ cảnh đèn vàng nhấp nháy báo hiệu pin cần sạc.

questions.stem: Ms. Rosen did not say ------- about the plans for a new employee break room.
questions.explanation: "Did not say anything" = không nói gì. "Anything" dùng trong câu phủ định để diễn tả "không có gì/điều gì".

questions.stem: Revenue growth exceeding 2 percent was seen ------- all business segments this quarter.
questions.explanation: "Across all business segments" = trên tất cả các phân khúc kinh doanh. "Across" diễn tả phạm vi bao phủ toàn bộ.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: Cần động từ chia ở thì hiện tại tiếp diễn vì sự cố đang xảy ra (email viết ngày 15/7, sự cố từ 14/7 và chưa khắc phục xong). "We are experiencing" = chúng tôi đang gặp phải.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following e-mail.

options.text: Our engineers are working on this problem now.
The new mobile app is easy to use, and it is available for free.
We have several openings for customer service representatives.
We are announcing the opening of a new Gold Star Bank location.

questions.explanation: Câu trước đề cập sự cố kỹ thuật với ứng dụng di động → câu tiếp cần giải thích công ty đang xử lý vấn đề. "Our engineers are working on this problem now." — "this problem" chỉ lại "technical difficulties".

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: "Within the next twenty-four hours" = trong vòng hai mươi bốn giờ tới. Giới từ "within" diễn tả khoảng thời gian dự kiến hoàn thành.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: "In the meantime" = trong thời gian chờ đợi. Câu trước nói ứng dụng sẽ hoạt động lại trong 24 giờ → câu tiếp cung cấp giải pháp tạm thời: trong khi chờ, có thể giao dịch tại chi nhánh.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following information.
questions.explanation: "Function as advertised" = hoạt động như đã quảng cáo. "Advertised" là quá khứ phân từ dùng như trạng từ bổ nghĩa cách thức sau "as".

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following information.

options.text: For certain products this period may be extended.
Bethenie Industries stores are located in three countries.
An electronic receipt was generated at that time.
Product samples are available in stores.

questions.explanation: Câu trước đề cập "at least one year" (ít nhất một năm) → câu bổ sung liên quan đến thời hạn bảo hành. "For certain products this period may be extended." — "this period" chỉ lại thời gian một năm.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following information.
questions.explanation: "This warranty applies only to..." = bảo hành này chỉ áp dụng cho... "Warranty" (bảo hành) phù hợp ngữ cảnh đảm bảo sản phẩm hoạt động và sửa chữa/đổi trả.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following information.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "packaging". "Original packaging" = bao bì gốc/ban đầu.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: Cần động từ chính chia ở thể bị động. "The sections... are scheduled to be under construction" = các khu vực... dự kiến sẽ được thi công.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: "Therefore" = do đó. Câu trước nói khu vực sẽ được thi công → kết quả là thực phẩm từ khu vực đó không có sẵn. "Therefore" diễn tả quan hệ nguyên nhân-kết quả.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: "The few days of inconvenience" = vài ngày bất tiện. "Few" dùng với danh từ đếm được số nhiều "days", phù hợp ngữ cảnh cải tạo chỉ kéo dài vài ngày.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following notice.

options.text: The store must close for three days.
Customers must park in the recently added parking area.
Ice-cream products will be available during the remodeling.
A special celebration will take place on August 12.

questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo đề cập "At this event" (tại sự kiện này) → câu trước cần giới thiệu một sự kiện. "A special celebration will take place on August 12." → "this event" chỉ lại "celebration".

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: "This yearly offering" = sự kiện thường niên này. "Yearly" (hàng năm) phù hợp với "annual Plant Showcase" (triển lãm cây trồng thường niên) ở đầu bài.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.

options.text: The company seeks out the most profitable sectors in agriculture.
The company interviews researchers from across the world.
The research and development team then works to develop varietals that address these difficulties.
Their extensive research produces some of the most flavorful plants on the market.

questions.explanation: Câu trước đề cập "customer surveys designed to gain an understanding of common challenges" → câu tiếp nói cách công ty giải quyết thách thức. "The research and development team then works to develop varietals that address these difficulties." — "these difficulties" chỉ lại "common challenges".

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: Cần danh từ số nhiều sau "desert" trong cụm "in desert regions" = ở các vùng sa mạc. "Regions" (các vùng) là danh từ số nhiều phù hợp.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: Cần đại từ thay thế cho "Gardeners" (người làm vườn - số nhiều) ở câu trước. "They" (họ) là đại từ số nhiều phù hợp.

questions.stem: What is indicated about Star Fitness Club?

options.text: It has just built a new facility.
It provides refreshments with paid membership.
It is currently selling its used exercise equipment.
It is open seven days a week.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "our brand-new building" (tòa nhà hoàn toàn mới)
Đáp án: "just built a new facility" (vừa xây dựng cơ sở mới)

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned about the special offer?

options.text: It expires at the end of June.
It can be used at any location.
It includes sessions with a personal trainer.
It is intended for new customers only.

questions.explanation: Bài đọc đề cập: hết hạn cuối tháng 6 (A✓), có hiệu lực tại mọi chi nhánh (B✓), chỉ dành cho thành viên mới (D✓). Tuy nhiên, KHÔNG đề cập đến buổi tập cùng huấn luyện viên cá nhân (C).

questions.stem: What is a purpose of the note?

options.text: To request feedback on a recent stay
To inform a guest of a location change
To invite a guest to a private event
To announce the opening of a new hotel

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:

Đáp án: "inform a guest of a location change" (thông báo cho khách về sự thay đổi địa điểm)

questions.stem: What is stated about the breakfast?

options.text: It is not available on weekends.
It will not be served on May 2.
It will soon feature more selections.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "complimentary" (miễn phí)
Đáp án: "free of charge" (miễn phí)

options.text: The design of the train stations
The schedule of the express trains

Đáp án: "The design of the train stations" (thiết kế của các nhà ga)

questions.stem: For what kind of business does Mr. Farley most likely work?
questions.explanation: Việc nhắc đến "the chef" (đầu bếp) và "menu description" (mô tả thực đơn) cho thấy đây là nhà hàng.

questions.stem: At 3:27 P.M., what does Mr. Farley mean when he writes, "I'm afraid we are all out"?

options.text: Staff members have no more ideas.

questions.explanation: Lisa hỏi còn sốt cà chua đông lạnh không → Travis trả lời "we are all out" (chúng ta đã hết) → nghĩa là mặt hàng đó không còn.

questions.stem: What will Belle Coffee do on January 12?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "debut our newest coffee creation" (ra mắt sáng tạo cà phê mới nhất)
Đáp án: "Introduce a new product" (giới thiệu sản phẩm mới)

questions.stem: According to the notice, what is available on the Web site?
questions.explanation: "To learn more" cho thấy trang web có thêm thông tin, bao gồm phiếu ưu đãi liên quan đến chương trình câu lạc bộ thành viên.

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Additional coffee products and pastries will be available for purchase."
questions.explanation: Vị trí [3] nằm sau phần mô tả các mẫu miễn phí (ly Latte Slow Brew và bánh muffin). Câu này bổ sung rằng ngoài mẫu miễn phí, khách hàng có thể mua thêm sản phẩm → liên kết tự nhiên nhất tại [3].

questions.stem: What opera will be performed without a break?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "no intermission" (không có giải lao)
Đáp án: "without a break" (không có giờ nghỉ)

questions.stem: What is probably true about the artists-in-residence?

options.text: They are all from the Dalston area.
They are younger than the regular performers.
They are professionally trained as dancers.
They are all well-known around the world.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "the next generation of talent" (thế hệ tài năng mới)
Đáp án: "younger than the regular performers" (trẻ hơn các nghệ sĩ chính)

questions.stem: Who most likely will perform in Le Lapin?
questions.explanation: Le Lapin diễn ra từ 6–14 tháng 7 và nghệ sĩ thường trú biểu diễn ngày 6 tháng 7 là Kalim Patton → ông Patton sẽ biểu diễn trong Le Lapin.

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the plans for the shipyard?
questions.explanation: Bài đọc đề cập: nhạc sống (B — Entertainment ✓), cửa hàng bán lẻ (C — shopping ✓), nhà hàng (D — eating ✓). Tuy nhiên KHÔNG đề cập văn phòng (A — Office spaces).

questions.stem: What is suggested about the Muelker Shipyard?

options.text: It will be featured in a video.
It will have a monument to former workers.
A ship is currently being built there.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "a strong reaction from community members... viewed the site as a treasured industrial landmark" (phản ứng mạnh từ cộng đồng... coi đây là di tích công nghiệp quý giá)
Đáp án: "Local residents appreciate its history" (cư dân địa phương trân trọng lịch sử của nó)

questions.stem: The word "serving" in paragraph 3, line 7, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: "Serving as" = đóng vai trò là = "functioning as" (hoạt động như). "Serving" đồng nghĩa với "functioning" trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Davis write the memo?

options.text: To ask employees to attend a training session
To request that employees work overtime
To provide details of a celebration
To announce the end of a project

questions.explanation:

Đáp án: "details of a celebration" (chi tiết của một lễ kỷ niệm)

questions.stem: What is suggested about Harkness Clothiers?

options.text: It has combined with another company.
It gives awards to staff every year.
It manufactures a line of waterproof clothes.
It has a very small customer service team.

questions.explanation:

Đáp án: "combined with another company" (kết hợp với một công ty khác)

questions.stem: When will an event take place in the morning?
questions.explanation: "Starting at 8 A.M." = bắt đầu lúc 8 giờ sáng → sự kiện vào buổi sáng là thứ Ba.

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "To show our appreciation, management is providing some opportunities to have fun this week."
questions.explanation: Vị trí [3] nằm ngay trước đoạn liệt kê các hoạt động hàng ngày (bữa sáng thứ Ba, bữa trưa thứ Tư, bữa tối thứ Năm, cuộc thi thứ Sáu). Câu giới thiệu "opportunities to have fun this week" dẫn vào danh sách hoạt động → [3] là vị trí phù hợp nhất.

questions.stem: Who can attend the sale on Friday?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "the library's volunteer support group" (nhóm tình nguyện viên hỗ trợ thư viện)
Đáp án: "Volunteers" (tình nguyện viên)

questions.stem: The word "welcome" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: "Welcome donations" = hoan nghênh/chấp nhận quyên góp = "accept donations". "Welcome" đồng nghĩa với "accept" trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.stem: What is indicated about journals?

options.text: They are located on the second floor.
They will be sold to volunteers only.

questions.explanation: Thông báo nói rõ không nhận tạp chí/tập san → tập san không thể được quyên góp.

questions.stem: When can donations be dropped off in the evening?

questions.stem: In what type of business are the writers involved?

questions.stem: What most likely is Ms. Park's job title?

questions.stem: What is indicated about Mr. Lim?

options.text: He was not able to complete a sale.
He is currently away on business.
He is a new member of the writers' department.
He has just signed a contract.

questions.stem: What is implied about Loretti Printing Co.?

It is merging with a card company.
It has expanded its paper selection.

options.text: Enter a code for a discount

It was for the wrong company.

Class sizes are limited to ten students.
Classes are held every weekday night.

To encourage a fellow writer to apply
To respond to a student's application
